checked_scope: workflow/compiler.go: specification decoding, strict field validation, feature discovery and ordering, Gherkin parsing and outline expansion, background/rule propagation, table and doc-string rendering, scenario coverage, prompt construction, task validation, and deterministic topological ordering
workflow/types.go: compiled plan and policy JSON/YAML shape
workflow/compiler_test.go and workflow/acceptance_test.go: unit and executable Gherkin acceptance coverage for compiler requirements

cmd/godog/internal/cmd_workflow.go, cmd/godog/main.go, and cmd/godog/internal/cmd_workflow_test.go: command registration, argument validation, plan JSON output, run result output, and failure propagation
docs/workflows/develop.yaml and docs/workflows/README.md: declared workflow policy and CLI contract

test_evidence.details: Both targeted packages passed with the race detector.

test_evidence.command: temporary standalone Go adversarial probe importing github.com/cucumber/godog/workflow
test_evidence.details: Confirmed task-level YAML merges retain explicit zero-attempt validation; merged unknown task fields are rejected; two compilations are byte identical; ready tasks are dependency-ordered deterministically; outline rows have distinct scenarios; feature and rule backgrounds, escaped tables, media-typed doc strings, and substitutions are retained; and Compile does not execute a sentinel task command. The temporary probe was removed after execution.

test_evidence.command: built ./cmd/godog executable exercised by temporary standalone Go probe
test_evidence.details: Confirmed workflow plan emits parseable byte-identical JSON on repeated runs without executing the sentinel command; workflow plan without SPEC exits nonzero with an argument-usage error; and workflow run returns nonzero for a failing task while stdout remains parseable result JSON reporting failed status. Temporary binary, repositories, and fixtures were outside the worktree and removed by the probe.
